customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as ARG in the Dockerfile. Renovate's built-in dockerfile manager only reads FROM lines, so the '# renovate:' annotations above each ARG are invisible without this.
Commits pinned as ARG in the Dockerfile. oh-my-zsh ships no tags, so there is no version to track - git-refs watches the named branch and bumps the digest.

packageRules.description: One grouped PR a week for the image toolchain rather than a PR per release - claude-code alone ships most days.
Patch and minor bumps land unattended once the image builds and every binary still runs. Majors always wait for a human.
herdr is pre-1.0 and ships weekly, so a 0.x minor is a breaking change in practice - the one bump worth eyeballing.
